conventions.moments: Sagging positive in kN m/m. Fixed-edge values are the normal bending moment.
conventions.deflection: Positive down for comparisons, in m.
conventions.reactions: Global Z up, in kN. Signed boundary nodes summed once. Corner comparisons use magnitude.
conventions.twisting: Corner comparisons use magnitude, with the signed moment retained separately.
conventions.fd_corner_force: Negative twice the FD corner twisting magnitude from the Kirchhoff corner relation.
